name: tracklands
description: TRACKLANDS: a cozy railway empire builder (Three.js PWA, no build step).

scripts.serve: node -e "import('./tests/lib.mjs').then(async (l) => { const s = await l.startServer(); console.log(s.url); })"
scripts.test:fast: node tools/check.mjs && node tests/run.mjs unit rail seeds savefuzz --cases=150 --corpus
scripts.native:check: node tools/version.mjs check && node tools/build-web.mjs --target=native && cd src-tauri && cargo fmt --check && cargo check --locked
